therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Multi-kinase inhibition including SRC family kinases
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of kinase signaling pathways involved in prostate cancer progression
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Disease control rate based on PSA, bone scan, FACT-P, and RECIST criteria

safety_signals: Relatively rapid PSA increases in most patients

context.investigator_commentary: Due to relatively poor drug tolerance and relatively rapid PSA increases in most patients it was not feasible to continue patients on treatment until there was radiographic evidence of disease progression
